newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian forwarders brand surcharges unacceptable.
newsitem.headline: Belgian forwarders brand surcharges unacceptable.

text.p: BAFI, the Belgian freight forwarders association, has branded the fuel surcharges being introduced by the carriers as "unacceptable and unprofessional."
"The way these increases have been introduced to the market is unacceptable and unprofessional," said BAFI chairman Jean-Claude Dalen."
The across-the-board increases are also wrong, he added. "It is the same surcharge if the cargo has to travel 300 kilometres or 3,000, which we cannot accept."
BAFI is calling for a meeting with OTM, the Belgian shippers association, " to discuss the lessons that can be learnt from this and make sure it does not happen again."
A letter has already been written to ACMAB, which is the association of air cargo managers, stating its objections and calling for a delay to the surcharge introductions.
Dalen stressed that the forwarders are not against carriers recuperating their costs but they would like it to be done in an "orderly way".
"We will accept those charges from December 1 but we can't recuperate those from the beginning of November."
BAFI wants to meet with ACMAB concerning the issue. Dalen added: "This should be a lesson for the future and has shown the lack of communication between the airlines and forwarders."
